venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV beat target +14.2% ($4,909 vs $4,300)** — fifth consecutive +target day; strong Sunday closing out the weekend streak. Food $699 + Bev $3,444 (note: form reports a low retail/floor reconciliation discrepancy; net came in at $4,909). 139 guests (Sevenrooms) / $35.32 computed GCA (form-stated 35). Comps $182.72 — NYTIMES press in-house, plus lots of investor/member combos. **Service shape**: slow open, **strong 9:30-11 push**, otherwise quiet flow-wise. 'Lots of pre and post dinners at the floor, fewer at bar — seems like a pattern.' 11 solos, 1 large party, 8 investor cocktails. Lots of investors & members across the weekend; one advantage: members have tried the investor menu, so Thomas could go deeper in the catalog. **Back catalog banger**: Seven Year Itch, the wardays 75 variation. **Top sellers**: First Time Listener, Material Control, Basilisk. **Service highlights**: managed 3-4 tickets at peak — channel knifed a Brandy Crusta by request, Metrograph subscription recommendation, wrote out a Kyosho cure recipe. **Door**: room filled with full bar + 90% full floor (short one large table), slowly dissipated by 7:45pm, then kept full rest of night. Member Keenan added himself to waitlist and was quickly accommodated; lots of NYers who hadn't visited in years left enthralled. **86's**: none noted. **Menu count**: 18. **Glassware**: 1 water (guest), 1 Collins (bar). **Maintenance**: checking on speaker tomorrow. No incident. No-shows charged. MOD & Chef: Seth & Alejandro. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG beat target +42.6% ($11,405 vs $8,000)** — fourth consecutive +target day; strong Sunday capping the streak. Segments: MB Morning $2,538, MB Evening $7,219, Sun Club $402, Hot Eye $1,132, Events $0. Food $4,582 (40.2% mix — highest food share in recent weeks). Comps $225. 238 guests (93 AM + 145 PM via OpenTable) / $47.92 GCA. **Morning (Sam & Lex)**: one of slower Sundays — very little action before 11am. A few hotel guests for breakfast but did not capture most departures. No large parties, but **~28 covers for food tours** (great extra business). Staffing paced well; **Aimee and Sofia did a great job running sidework**. Not a lot of brunch food sold. **Evening (Justin & Shannon)**: started looking at 30 covers, most in first half. **Trustees Theater Comedy Show for Judd Apatow and friends filming The Comeback King** in town started at 7pm — went from very chill at 5pm to **packed house by 6:15pm**. Kitchen had rail filled in 20 minutes, executed flawlessly without long ticket times. James was solo behind the bar at start, **Chandler arrived at 6 just in time** for the rush. Kelwin stayed past his brunch shift to help take tables (huge!). **Killer hour 6-7pm**, then at 7pm 'biggest exodus of folks out of the space I've seen since opening.' A few more groups came in for dinner over the following hours but stayed calm; **not much post-show crowd in MB at all**. **Sun Club (Nicki / Sam)**: good business at open from hotel guests, very slow evening after that. **Hot Eye**: pretty chill night, very slow start, steady flow after 9pm. Normal bar crawl followed by service industry. 'Slow burn.' **Lots of invites sent out for tomorrow night's event.** **Kitchen**: 911 on Branzino and Mushrooms. 'Great job, BOH!' No DNL/sendbacks noted. No injury/incident, no maintenance flags. **Highlight**: 'seeing a literal line out the door!' Entered by Alexis.
